tagline: The Shopify connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta.
what_it_does: The Shopify connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the Previews page. The connector ingests e commerce data such as products, orders, customers, inventory, fulfillments, and discounts from Shopify into Databricks.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
